snippet.title: Version 2.1 Teaser - "The Impending Crash of Waves" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
The peak of summer arrives right on cue
and the tides ebb and flow
bringing memories bright as fireworks
and awakening sleepless fragments of the past.

"Even if I must face the winds again, towards the vast expanse where sea meets sky..."
"In this moment, we are no longer walking alone."

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5™/iOS/Android/PC/Xbox | Version 2.0 "Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
